profile.copy: I design the systems users never see but always feel: reliable APIs, clear service boundaries, efficient data paths, and infrastructure that stays calm under load.

principles.title: How I build.
principles.copy: Not motivational quotes — operating rules derived from running production systems under real load.

list.title: Reliability before optimization
list.detail: A system that recovers predictably beats a fast system that fails silently. Correctness, idempotent writes, and explicit failure modes come first — speed follows.

list.title: Simple architecture that scales
list.detail: Stateless services, one source of truth, horizontal scaling. Complexity must earn its place: every added component is a component that can fail at 3AM.

list.title: Production is the only real benchmark
list.detail: Capacity is proven with load tests before traffic arrives, and behavior is measured with metrics, logs, and alerts — not assumed from benchmarks.

list.title: Own the full lifecycle
list.detail: From schema design to deployment to incident response. A system is not done when it ships — it is done when it can be operated calmly.
